calibration/t1-swatches.pes.title: T1 calibration card: thread swatches and coverage ramp
calibration/t1-swatches.pes.about: Six threads (White, Black, Red, Blue, Yellow, Leaf Green) as 12 mm fills at 3.0, 4.5 and 6.0 rows/mm, then Black at 0.5, 1, 1.5, 2, 3 and 4.5 rows/mm, all without underlay; the "T1" mark is the top left. Photographed under the protocol below, it calibrates the Realistic view and the similarity scorer (image-similarity plan, T1), shows how each density covers the fabric (#129), and whether a single layer without underlay sews cleanly. The card's photo patch is the Photo Stitch 1 sunset demo in OpenStitch mode (`image-tools/S-photo1-sunset-openstitch.pes`).

calibration/ps2-grey-ramp.pes.title: Photo Stitch 2 coverage ramp
calibration/ps2-grey-ramp.pes.about: An eight-step grey ramp (`grey-ramp.png`, white to black) as Photo Stitch 2 sews it in one Black thread: how much of each grey its line screen covers, the data the Photo Stitch 2 coverage model needs (#129).

calibration/satin-and-underlay.pes.title: Satin widths and underlay
calibration/satin-and-underlay.pes.about: Black satin columns 1, 1.5, 2, 2.5, 3, 4 and 6 mm wide and 40 mm long (OpenStitch mode keeps satin for strokes up to 2.5 mm), then two Red fills at 4.5 rows/mm, without underlay (left) and with it (right): whether narrow satins sew whole and whether the single layer holds.

machine-checks/satin-zigzag-rect.pes.title: Machine check: Region satin is a zigzag across the column
machine-checks/satin-zigzag-rect.pes.about: Sew this file on a Brother machine on medium-weight woven cotton with tear-away stabiliser; look for needle holes or ragged thread along the two long edges (there should be none) and record the result. The record goes in `compat/machine/stitches/satin-zigzag-rect.json` (spec `satin-zigzag-rect`).

machine-checks/machine-formats.pes.title: Machine check: Machine formats carry the same stitches, trims and colour stops as PE-DESIGN 11's exports
machine-checks/machine-formats.pes.about: Sew this file on a Brother single-needle machine (medium-weight woven cotton, tear-away stabiliser): the two Red lines must sew with one thread cut between them (no thread span across the 40 mm gap), the machine must stop once for Black, and the satin must sew its 15 mm stitches whole with no needle holes along the long edges. Record the result, the cut, and whether the machine showed the design as 40 x 40 mm. The record goes in `compat/machine/machine/machine-formats.json` (spec `machine-formats`).

machine-checks/shape-start-points.pes.title: Machine check: Shape-tool shapes start and end where PE-DESIGN 11 puts them
machine-checks/shape-start-points.pes.about: Sew this file on a Brother machine (medium-weight woven cotton, tear-away): seven colour stops in drawing order; each shape starts and ends at the bottom middle of its outline; every move between shapes is cut (no thread span on top). Record the result. The record goes in `compat/machine/stitches/shape-start-points.json` (spec `shape-start-points`).

machine-checks/pes-default-v6.pes.title: Machine check: Default PES is version 6 with objects and a thread table
machine-checks/pes-default-v6.pes.about: Copy this file to a USB stick, load it on a Brother machine and sew it; record whether it loads, its colour changes and how it sews. The record goes in `compat/machine/pes/pes-default-v6.json` (spec `pes-default-v6`).

fills/region-sew-types-1.pes.title: Region sew types (1 of 2)
fills/region-sew-types-1.pes.about: Nine region sew types, left to right, top to bottom: fill, satin, programmable fill (diamonds), motif fill (heart), piping, cross stitch, concentric circle, radial, spiral.

fills/region-sew-types-2.pes.title: Region sew types (2 of 2)
fills/region-sew-types-2.pes.about: Flexible spiral, stippling, net fill (square), zigzag net fill (honeycomb), decorative fill (waves), contour fill as rings and as a double spiral (beyond PE-DESIGN), programmable fill (bricks) with base sewing, motif fill (leaf).

fills/fill-options.pes.title: Fill and satin options
fills/fill-options.pes.about: Fill at 45°, continuous gradation to 20 %, gradation pattern, feathered edges, Stitch Type 2 (sloped rows), OpenStitch's random stagger, frequency 0 (no stagger), Auto direction on a circle, and satin with pull compensation and split stitches.

fills/underlay-styles.pes.title: Underlay styles
fills/underlay-styles.pes.about: No underlay, edge, zigzag, edge + zigzag, double (crossing layers), PE-DESIGN's first type (edge and rows), its second (edge and lattice), centre piping under a satin, and light underlay density.

fills/holes-and-emboss.pes.title: Hole sewing, engraving and embossing
fills/holes-and-emboss.pes.about: Top left: hole sewing (the blue ring is sewn around the yellow centre, not under it). Then a star as an engraved line, an engraved region and an embossed region in a red fill.

lines/line-sew-types.pes.title: Line sew types
lines/line-sew-types.pes.about: Top to bottom: running, triple, zigzag, motif (wave), stem, candlewick, E stitch, V stitch, chain.

shapes/shape-tools.pes.title: Shape tools
shapes/shape-tools.pes.about: Preset star, heart, crescent, arrow, teardrop and hexagon; then a skeleton satin of changing width, a curved Manual Punch column, and a floral pattern inside a circle.

shapes/decorative-frames.pes.title: Decorative frames
shapes/decorative-frames.pes.about: Five Shape-tool frames (scallop, wave, zigzag, scallop oval, corners) around small circles, and the laurel frame from the decorative library.

lettering/fonts-and-text.pes.title: Lettering
lettering/fonts-and-text.pes.about: Lato Bold and Pacifico, a Text Transform arch, and text spaced around a circle (text on a path).

lettering/monograms.pes.title: Monograms
lettering/monograms.pes.about: The four monogram styles (block, script, diamond, circle), each in a decorative frame, for the 150 × 150 mm hoop.

wizards/applique.pes.title: Appliqué wizard
wizards/applique.pes.about: A heart as appliqué: material line, stop, position line, stop, tack-down, stop, covering zigzag. Lay the fabric at the first stop, trim it at the second.

wizards/patch.pes.title: Embroidered patch wizard
wizards/patch.pes.about: A heart with a satin border and a sewn cutting line outside it, to cut the patch out with scissors.

wizards/cutwork.pes.title: Cutwork wizard
wizards/cutwork.pes.about: A circle cutout: stabilising run, a sewn cut line (the NV880E has no cutwork needles, so cut by hand at the stop), stabiliser run, net fill and covering satin. Use water-soluble stabiliser.

wizards/background-fill.pes.title: Background fill wizard
wizards/background-fill.pes.about: Stippling inside a circle around a heart, keeping a 3 mm gap.
